Partner Groups

We believe in the power of shared duty. By weaving with like-minded organizations, we host collaborative events that strengthen the whole, ensuring our collective impact provides for generations to come.

Collaborative impact

No organization does this work alone. BOTR actively partners with aligned communities, businesses, wellness practitioners, and leaders who share our commitment to conscious community and human flourishing.

  • Co-hosted events and councils
  • Cross-community retreats and gatherings
  • Referral and support networks
  • Collaborative fundraising for community initiatives

Become a partner

If your organization is aligned with our values and you're interested in co-creating something together, we'd love to hear from you. Reach out through our contact page.
